mainEntity.name: How do I check that a school is CTEC-approved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Search the school in CTEC’s Find an Education Provider directory before you pay. Only hours from an approved provider count toward your registration.

mainEntity.name: Who reports my completed hours to CTEC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your education provider. CTEC-approved providers report completed CE and QE hours to CTEC and the IRS electronically, so your record stays current.

mainEntity.name: What can I do if a school does not meet CTEC standards?

acceptedAnswer.text: CTEC has formal provider policies, including course evaluations and a complaint process. Review them on CTEC’s provider policies page or contact CTEC directly.
